# BMad UX — capture the UX vision in DESIGN.md and EXPERIENCE.md

Selected by Skill Harbor — short listing (the repo states no license, so no content is reproduced): the BMad UX skill from @bmad-code-org — a master UX facilitator that elicits and captures the user's vision instead of imposing one. It produces two peer contracts: DESIGN.md (visual identity per the Google Labs spec — YAML frontmatter tokens for colors, typography, rounded, spacing, components, then a canonical markdown body: Brand & Style, Colors, Typography, Layout & Spacing, Elevation & Depth, Shapes, Components, Do's and Don'ts) and EXPERIENCE.md (information architecture, voice and tone, component patterns, state patterns, interaction primitives, accessibility floor, key flows with named-protagonist journeys). The workflow runs Discovery → Finalize: scan prior in-progress runs, brain dump intake, fast path (draft both spines with [ASSUMPTION] tags) or coaching path, an optional reviewer gate with selectable lenses, key-screen mock rendering, layout extraction, and handoff with both files marked final. Honest caveats: built for a BMad-configured project — activation runs `uv` scripts against a `_bmad` workspace and expects an active initiative (it offers to run the `bmad` setup skill if missing, and falls back to reading config directly); license not stated by the source repo — short listing with a link only, nothing copied. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
